status: Retrospective follow-up. Six and eight pulses were nominated from the already scored ten-schedule benchmark.
primary: Replay each of the two original single-pulse fits, zeroing all six z/h filter coordinates immediately before the second and each later pulse. Keep reporter states continuous; keep the measured TF trajectory, every parameter, original normalization and integration unchanged. No reset during or after the last pulse. Compare the ensemble with the frozen intact neural-rate gW and intact latent ODE.
controls: Replay intact per-seed trajectories against the sealed originals. Repeat reset at the start of each intervening gap (earlier pulse offset), and repeat resetting only at the final inter-pulse boundary (last pulse onset). Repeat primary with half integration step. Treat variations as sensitivity checks.
score: Original 5-minute reporter grid strictly after final removal through 120 minutes. Report both panels, all target-level errors and signed contributions MSE(latent) minus MSE(intact). Positive favors neural-rate. Per-target share of net gain uses the signed sum over seven promoters. Equal promoter weighting; equal schedule weighting when pooled. Inspect average signed reporter residual to describe over- or under-prediction. Report both seeds.
mechanism: At frozen readouts, decompose intact-minus-reset reporter predictions after shutoff into the decayed difference already present at shutoff plus the contribution from differences in ongoing memory-dependent production. The direct TF term cancels. Summaries of mean signed prediction shifts are descriptive.
